name: Canada blueberry
desc: Canada blueberry (Vaccinium myrtilloides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Vaccinium myrtilloides is a North American species of blueberry with common names including common blueberry, velvetleaf huckleberry, velvetleaf blueberry, Canadian blueberry, and sourtop blueberry.
